action_items: Real provider credentials, Gemini OAuth, and live search remain unavailable by environment design; MOCK Statx Demo was used for chat verification.
Three browser checks required selector/assertion refinement and passed on rerun; classify as flaky per test protocol.

checks.criterion: User can register or log in and reach the Statx dashboard
checks.name: auth-dashboard-registration
checks.evidence: Registration UI submitted a fresh tscheck account; redirected to /app; dashboard heading 'Good to see you.' and Connected AI stat visible.

checks.name: statx-routes-sidebar-render
checks.evidence: After selector refinement, sidebar navigation rendered /workspace, /conversations, /providers, /documents, /competency, /results, /assessment, and /settings with non-empty main content.

checks.criterion: Provider dashboard separates selection from authorization
checks.name: provider-selection-authorization-boundary
checks.evidence: Provider cards/status dots rendered; OpenAI selection changed to 'In routing'; Gemini remained 'Not connected' after connect attempt. Missing OAuth produced expected HTTP 503 console response, with no false connected state.

checks.name: chat-thread-persists-provider-context
checks.evidence: Fresh thread accepted prompt, rendered user and assistant messages with provider label 'demo', and retained prompt after reload.

checks.criterion: Search controls are visible and honest
checks.name: workspace-search-mode-honesty
checks.evidence: Auto, Web, and AI only controls visible; Web selection showed 'Live web search' context and live-sources composer placeholder without claiming retrieved sources.

checks.criterion: Protected access and logout behave safely
checks.name: protected-access-logout-boundary
checks.evidence: Sign out returned to /login; direct /app navigation while unauthenticated redirected to /login and dashboard was absent. API requests returned expected 401s in console.

checks.criterion: Auth API supports registration, session identity, logout, and login
checks.name: test_tscheck_auth
checks.evidence: HTTP assertions: POST /api/auth/register 200; GET /api/auth/me 200; POST /api/auth/logout then /me 401; POST /api/auth/login 200.

checks.criterion: Provider API separates selection from authorization
checks.name: test_tscheck_providers
checks.evidence: HTTP assertions: GET /api/providers 200; PATCH /api/providers/preferences 200; GET /api/providers/gemini/connect 503 with 'not configured'.

checks.criterion: Chat API persists context and provider attribution
checks.name: test_tscheck_chat
checks.evidence: HTTP assertions: POST /api/conversations 200; POST /api/conversations/{id}/messages 200 with provider_id demo; GET detail 200 containing user and assistant rows.

checks.criterion: Protected API data rejects unauthenticated access
checks.name: test_tscheck_protected
checks.evidence: HTTP assertions: unauthenticated GET /api/conversations 401 and /api/providers 401; after logout GET /api/auth/me 401.

checks.criterion: Search API does not claim Web success without credential
checks.name: test_tscheck_search
checks.evidence: HTTP assertion: POST /api/conversations/{id}/messages with search_mode web returned 503 containing search_unavailable.
